correctness.rationale: From the printed ODE, the two equilibria are exactly E_±=(±sqrt(b),±sqrt(b),0,0). The characteristic polynomial is λ^4+(a+c)λ^3+(ac+b)λ^2+b(2a+c+1)λ+2ab(c+1). Its third Hurwitz determinant equals -b times a polynomial whose every displayed monomial is positive for a,b,c>0, so it is strictly negative. Zero and purely imaginary eigenvalues are excluded; the positive octant is connected; and an exact Routh count at (a,b,c)=(1,1,2) gives exactly two right-half-plane roots. The dependency-free verify.py replays the determinant and exact sign identities.
